environment.hardware_target: Apple Silicon (MPS supported, CPU deterministic execution)

experiments.title: Supervised Baseline Comparison on 180-dim Behavioral Features
experiments.key_finding: Raw uncalibrated features fail (Logistic Regression 50.0%, Random Forest 50.0%), whereas Parent-Anchored Standardization elevates all detectors (Logistic Regression, Random Forest, GBDT, PyTorch MLP) to 100.0% accuracy on held-out physical Qwen targets.

experiments.title: Unseen Checkpoint Generalization & Data Leakage Prevention
experiments.key_finding: Strict grouping isolates the Qwen target family from training. Detectors trained on LLaMA-3 and Mistral-7B achieve 100% TPR and 0% FPR on physical Qwen checkpoints. Critical scientific disclosure: Physical test cohort contains N=1 trojan checkpoint; cannot prove universal cross-architecture generalization without larger physical cohorts.

experiments.title: Internal Model Representations vs. Behavioral Signals Audit
experiments.key_finding: Hidden state dimensions differ fundamentally across architectures (LLaMA/Mistral=4096 vs Qwen=1536), preventing direct zero-shot transfer without learned projection distortion. Furthermore, intermediate hidden activation extraction demands 14-16 GB VRAM and hook overhead, whereas 180-dim logit behavioral statistics are universal, lightweight (<100 KB), and black-box queryable.

experiments.title: EfficientNet Feasibility Assessment & Structured MBConv Benchmark
experiments.key_finding: Standard ImageNet EfficientNet-B0 (5.3M params) is structurally misaligned due to lack of 2D spatial locality and extreme parameter overcapacity. A parameter-scaled MBConv network (4,321 params) on the structured (30x6) probe matrix matches 100% accuracy, but provides zero empirical benefit over simpler Behavioral MLP (13,889 params) or linear Logistic Regression (180 params).
